sourceOccurrences.label: Finite witnesses and Harris applications
sourceOccurrences.note: 22S9 covers finite intersections. H4OA and 5CN6 cover upper-set and finite-witness arguments; the connection and escape discussion retains arbitrary vertex subsets. X5SS applies to pairs of connection, escape and infinite-cluster events, including a mixed connection/infinite-cluster pair. UPFU is the three-point lower bound. Cluster growth and path witnesses supply the graph monotonicity steps. The larger Harris module and its general ordered-coordinate integration helpers are not included in this module census.

sourceOccurrences.label: Complement duality and decreasing, mixed and function forms
sourceOccurrences.relationship: Complete grouped source contracts with the canonical increasing-event theorem reused
sourceOccurrences.note: CW1V complements the profile and configuration. F4CV gives decreasing and mixed event inequalities, including their real-probability forms. KM1K covers the s-finite layer-cake identities and the two superlevel-to-integral comparisons. E9HR gives the three extended nonnegative function forms; T6WJ gives the three bounded real forms. Arbitrary coordinate types, explicit measurability, zero/infinite conventions and the separate signed integrability requirements are retained. No proof status or reviewed correspondence is authored.

sourceOccurrences.note: EZJ7 states the full-space finite Boolean version for nonnegative finite real functions, without monotonicity or strict positivity. It does not claim coverage of the more general finite distributive-lattice theorem or arbitrary subfamilies.

sourceOccurrences.label: Finite-measure FKG and Holley contracts
sourceOccurrences.relationship: Source-inspected statement correspondence with additional deductions identified
sourceOccurrences.note: TKDC gives the lattice-condition function and event inequalities; KB49 gives Holley comparison, with its observable form and signed-function extension supplied by the displayed four-functions proof. The source itself exports nonnegative function FKG and increasing-event Holley. Product lattice equality and ordered-profile Holley retain zero/one parameters. The real-mass conversion helper at line 47 permits arbitrary index types under a finite-measure assumption; the association and comparison exports require a finite configuration space.

sourceOccurrences.label: Bond non-connection and volume association
sourceOccurrences.note: The bond examples apply F4CV and E9HR with countable graph-event measurability. Infinite susceptibility is allowed; no covariance subtraction or conditioning on a null event is used.

sourceOccurrences.label: Harris inside domains and escape transfer
sourceOccurrences.note: EWMP gives the internal and full escape transfers. Internal positive association and finite-family inequalities reuse X5SS and 22S9. The source retains ambient countability as well as countability of the induced domain; no disjointness of paths or domains is assumed.
